data.name: Anyone can copy a public key. This step proves you hold its private key, which stays on your computer.
data.value: 任何人都可以複製公開金鑰。此步驟可證明您持有其私密金鑰，該金鑰會保留在您的電腦上。

data.name: I have a YubiKey / Hardware key
data.value: 我攜帶 YubiKey / 硬體金鑰

data.name: I use a private key file
If time runs out, add the key again.
data.value: 如果時間耗盡，請重新新增金鑰。

data.name: If your private key is stored elsewhere, change the path after -f. Then paste the complete signature printed by the command.
data.value: 如果您的私密金鑰儲存在其他位置，請變更 -f 之後的路徑。然後貼上該命令列印出的完整簽章。

data.name: Make sure your key is loaded in your SSH agent (for example by running ssh-add -K for resident keys), then run:
data.value: 請先確保金鑰已載入到 SSH agent（例如針對 Resident 金鑰執行 ssh-add -K），然後執行：

data.name: The signature did not match. Run the command above with the private key for this public key and paste the complete result.
data.value: 簽章不符。請使用此公開金鑰對應的私鑰執行上述指令，並貼上完整的結果。

data.name: To finish adding this key, run the command below on the computer that holds its private key.
data.value: 要完成此金鑰的添加，請在持有其私鑰的電腦上執行以下命令。

data.name: Touch your YubiKey when it flashes to complete the signing. Then paste the complete signature printed by the command.
data.value: 當 YubiKey 閃爍時輕觸它以完成簽署。然後貼上該命令輸出的完整簽署。

data.name: Verification expired. This key was not added.
data.value: 驗證已過期。此金鑰未被新增。
